step.cmd: Print a copy of the proof of death, add the SIN and write “PA” on the bottom right-hand corner of the page. Send the document identified as Protected B to the regional processing centre responsible for preparing documents for imaging.
In FTS, determine if the deceased client is exempted from reporting:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and cancel the exemption by completing the following fields:
Determine if there are any returned payments. For additional information, refer to Returned payment :
In FTS, if there is no registration number, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Work item: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is not in MPS, select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
If the claim is in MPS, select 93 - Manual Pay System .

Work Type: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is not in MPS, select 24 - Cancelled payment .
If the claim is in MPS, select 43 - Cancelled payment .
Remarks lines 1 and 2: Type “Deceased client. No representative is on file. Cancel the following payments in SPS and adjust the claim file:”

Remarks lines 3 and 4: Type “T071-2 [for the current year] or T071-8 [for the previous year]/reason F/wc [XXXX]/CT [XX]/gross amount [XXXX]/federal tax [XX]/provincial tax [XX]/net amount [XXXX]/PRN [XXXXXXXXXXXX].”
Remarks line 5: Type your first and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if benefits were paid for the period following the date of the death:
Determine what type of benefits the client was paid in the week of the date of death:

ul.li: If regular benefits were paid, go to step 20.
If special benefits were paid, go to step 21.

step.cmd: On the Payments tab, select the appropriate Report Week and modify the claimant’s report as follows:

ul.li: Non-available day(s): Select the number of days after the date of death
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select E - Non-fraud - Paid beyond termination .
Message: Select 23 - An overpayment resulted because you were paid after benefit period .

step.cmd: In FTS, if there is no registration number, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction and impose the D39 disentitlement as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Disentitlement: Select 39 - Prevent payment of part II benefits and/or incorrect Part 1 benefits .
Start date: Enter the day after the client’s date of death.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Complete: Select C - Yes to clear the registration number.
